pages.title: Where to fly
pages.text: Elytra only work in the Overworld and the End. In the Nether gliding will not start, and on planets you cannot wear them: a GalaxySpace spacesuit is required there, and its chestplate takes their slot.

pages.title: Where to get them
pages.text: Elytra lie on End City ships. The End is the pack's last goal: an Eye of Ender needs a coral from $(l:space/planets/tau_ceti)Tau Ceti F$(). Fireworks stack only to 3 per slot, so the supply is limited.

pages.title: Repair
pages.text: Anvil: elytra on the left, a $(l:vainlla+/World#biotite)Block of Biotite$() on the right. It restores a quarter of the durability for 3 levels, keeping enchantments, dye and name. Leather and books do not work on elytra.

pages.title: Dragon Scale
pages.text: Drops only from a respawned dragon, one at a time. Elytra and a scale in a crafting grid give two pairs of elytra, and the new pair is black.

pages.title: Dyeing
pages.text: Elytra can be dyed in a crafting grid with any dye, like leather armor.
